desc:
🥚 Welcome to Steal A Giant!

How to Play:
🥚 Steal eggs from powerful Guardians
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare Giants
💰 Earn money from your Giants
⬆️ Upgrade your treadmill and base
🏃 Train on the treadmill to gain Speed
🏏 Use your bat to steal eggs from other players
🌎 Explore new biomes and discover rarer Giants
⚖️ Find heavier eggs and hatch MASSIVE Giants!
✨ Discover Secret, Eternal, and Divine Giants!

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players
